items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: I did a recording project with her a few years ago

ctx.x: Incredible pianist and musician. And she uses all these weird chords. And so I did a recording project with her a few years ago, the music of Marian McPartland. Did you hear that?

I did Mary Lou. She did Marian McPartland. And so she writes all these weird chords so I was just writing a tune this week and I started to really hear those weird chords. So I’m always trying to grow, you know, with the harmony and the rhythm — you know, odd meters and everything.
